title: Jubilant Venezuelan Pudding
description: A traditional Venezuelan dessert with a sweet and creamy pudding made with jubilant dates.
instructions: Combine pudding mix and sugar in a large bowl.
Gradually add in evaporated milk, whisking until smooth.
Chop jubilant dates and add to the mixture.
Whisk in vanilla extract, if using.
Pour mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or until chilled.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional jubilant dates if desired.
